reviewed_locators: PDF page 6: Protein Half Life Analysis
PDF pages 35 and 340: headers of Tables S1 and S2
supplement.review_scope: Selected methods and table headers, not exhaustive review of all supplementary pages

quantification_methodology.role: Primary experimental methodology reference supporting dynamic-range, background and normalization review, not validation of the Lu assay.

image_inspection.method: Poppler pdfimages listing and native JPEG extraction followed by visual inspection; no enhancement or band densitometry
image_inspection.scope: These properties describe the complete assembled Figure 2 image, not a raw detector exposure or each individual blot.
image_inspection.image_resolution_conclusion: Sufficient for reading panel/lane labels; resolution alone does not establish quantitative signal quality.

assessment.finding: Five chase times and treatment/genotype groups can be read.
IKZF1 shows multiple bands. A quantitative selection/combination rule is not established.
Published appearance cannot establish a linear quantitative range or prove saturation. No accepted calibration/exposure data for this assay were identified in the reviewed material.
Raw exposures and a panel-specific background-subtraction rule are not available in the reviewed records. JPEG encoding alone is not a sufficient exclusion criterion.
Vinculin is shown, but a numerical normalization rule and quantitative control range are not established.
Figure 2D-specific replicate counts and numerical variability are unresolved. Reporter/qPCR replication is not imported.
Cell culture lists RPMI for MM1S; the generic chase method says DMEM.
Reviewed Table S1/S2 headers concern reporter-screen/retest data; these are not treated as the Figure 2D protein-loss time series.
A perturbed cellular chase at one drug condition does not establish patient response or a general concentration-effect function.

retained_use: Source-linked qualitative mechanism illustration and assay metadata.
next_action: Search for author-provided or published numerical protein-abundance time courses with units, controls, replicates, normalization and assay context. Prefer several exposure levels if a concentration-effect model is the goal.
reconsideration_conditions: Raw or author-provided assay data with provenance
Defined analyte/band measurement and quantitative range
Resolved or explicitly bounded assay context
limitation: Project selection decision, not a claim that the published experiment is invalid or that no usable data exist elsewhere. No band intensities, degradation constants, half-lives or clinical effects are inferred.
